meta.note: One row per dated map, or one row per series with a years list and a {year} placeholder in the tile URL. year is the year the publisher gives the map, and yearBasis says what that year means. The interface shows the map nearest to the selected step and states the distance in years; beyond maxGap it offers the map on request instead of showing it by default. A city with no drawable row shows what is needed. A row with placeholder true is a lead that has been recorded but has no georeferenced file yet and is never drawn. kind arcgis-image draws named rasters of an Esri image service, one exportImage call per tile.
